trusted_basis.test_cli_rule: Resolve exact CTest discovery; unmatched regex is failure, never PASS.

obligations.requirement: Current call paths, owners, narrow ports, ordering, failure and close behavior are frozen before production mutation.
obligations.oracle: ImplementationDesignPreflight records Host/Windows/Web to Runtime to Session/Operation/Scene/Frame/Control flow against Current Authority.
obligations.acceptance: No unresolved semantic, authority, verification or scope decision; every O1-O5 item maps to an executable oracle.

obligations.requirement: All input retains source/pointer/generation identity through Runtime; source loss and late generations cannot affect another session.
obligations.oracle: Two-source same-pointer, unregister/source-loss, generation reuse and late Move/Up/Cancel schedule with per-source ledger.
obligations.acceptance: Only owning Session receives keyed Cancel; stale samples rejected; valid next Down creates a fresh generation; zero pressure and provenance preserved.

obligations.requirement: Brush, object/partial eraser, creation, selection/transform and pan lifecycle decisions are owned by shared Runtime Session owners.
obligations.oracle: Brush to Shape to Line/Arrow cycles, selection click, move/scale/rotate commit/cancel, tool switch, focus/capture loss and document/view rebind.
obligations.acceptance: No Host duplicate behavior decision; cancel creates no canonical mutation; old position has no duplicate or flashback; accepted eraser pixel semantics remain unchanged.

obligations.requirement: OperationEngine, History, Scene publication and Preview/Canonical handoff use existing owners and one commit path.
obligations.oracle: Committed operation/change-set/history/scene/facade readback plus preview retirement, queued capture fencing, resize/maximize/lost/restored and stale worker tasks.
obligations.acceptance: One canonical write owner; preview replaces edited original; late work cannot resurrect retired preview; no fabricated Presented feedback.

obligations.requirement: Windows/Web and Control/Diagnostics consume the shared Runtime path; platform business/session branches and independent Ink Playground HUD are retired.
obligations.oracle: Windows/Web adapter fixtures and debug-on/off contract tests verify normalized batches, Up/Cancel semantics, pressure zero, pointer provenance, shared snapshots and no HUD residue.
obligations.acceptance: Common behavior is equivalent across Windows/Web; debug-off builds remain usable without HUD symbols; controls and readback come from the same Runtime owner.

obligations.requirement: A minimal non-Playground Host and adapter fixtures prove end-to-end equivalence while legacy duplicate entry points are removed or forwarding wrappers.
obligations.oracle: Build/run minimal Host fixture, Windows/Web adapter fixture, CTest regression matrix, source consumer inventory and protected-path audit.
obligations.acceptance: No second Document/Session/Scene/History/Frame truth; exact result/evidence is reviewer-accessible; Android remains deferred.

obligations.requirement: Only authorized runtime, host, adapter, test and evidence paths change and prior controls remain byte-identical.
obligations.oracle: Exact diff from task anchor, protected manifest hashes, git diff check and previous package/result identity audit.
obligations.acceptance: No Authority/Gate/Evidence/Integration/history mutation and no product semantics/schema expansion.

obligations.requirement: Existing input, interaction, render, control, DUI and FC-01 regression contracts remain active.
obligations.oracle: Exact discovered CTest targets listed in execution-contract.json; each target must exist and pass with assertions active.
obligations.acceptance: No frozen regression is weakened, renamed to evade execution, or silently omitted.
